claim: COVID-19 pandemic pre-planned with the help from Bill Gates.
justification: The claim is refuted based on high-confidence evidence: scientific consensus and peer-reviewed studies confirm SARS-CoV-2 originated naturally without deliberate engineering; no official investigations by bodies like the WHO have concluded the pandemic was pre-planned; and multiple credible fact-checkers have debunked the conspiracy, showing no credible evidence linking Bill Gates to planning the pandemic. Actions such as co-hosting Event 201 are verified as pandemic preparedness simulations, not evidence of actual planning, and there are no documented communications, financial transactions, or whistleblowers supporting the claim.
